description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for consistency transaction tests using xUnit in the Orleans framework. It includes test data attributes for various concurrency scenarios and overrides a method to run randomized consistency tests with different parameters.

classes.name: ConsistencyTransactionTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: An abstract class extending the base consistency transaction test runner, specialized for xUnit testing framework, providing test data for various concurrency scenarios.

methods.name: RandomizedConsistency
methods.description: Overrides the base method to execute randomized consistency tests with specified parameters, including concurrency levels and read/write determinations.
